points.text: Restored early-hide watcher in tools/run_shots.py that matches by process ID so only the shot Godot window is hidden.
Window is moved off-screen and given WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW so it does not appear in the taskbar; other Godot instances are left alone.
Shot window is forced borderless at 1920×1080 so the client area is not reduced by the title bar.
Journal UI reference re-captured at scale 50 into design/refs/ui-png-art/journal-ui.png.
Resized existing .jpg survey refs in design/refs/ui-png-art/ to a context-friendly size.
Fixed doc_patch._ensure_summary so a later call can replace an existing Summary line.

entries.summary: Shot window now hides immediately by PID (no taskbar flash, no effect on other Godot instances); journal ref and survey jpgs resized; changelog summary can be updated.

entries.summary: Finished task crystal-frame-pink: Crystal frame studs: stop deriving from the mis-keyed pink.

points.text: Updated UI rework task for more reliable results.
Combat: free previous HP-bar ImageTexture and telegraph meshes on update to stop leaks.
Enemy present: hop/fly lift moves body Y instead of always pinning to ground.
Player and enemy collision shapes now track visual height and feet.
Boss door removes itself and hotspots from interact groups when opened.
Anvil: tab change mid-forge calls cancel_job so paid materials are surfaced.
Anvil analyze: shows result text and leaves the sub open for more items.
Crystal map: free previous AtlasTexture on every aim to stop leaks.
Finished task bug-sweep-combined: Bug sweep findings.
Cleaned leftover notes about the old needs-local source-plate linking from the task and tools docs. _src remains the live durable-source folder.
Updated web sessions protocols to emit changelogs when appropriate.
Added .gdignore files to improve Godot import speeds.
Metal HUD strip with a mana bar under HP and a threat gem on the right. A special does not start when mana is short. Orbs, potions, and food restore mana. Settings can hide the gem.

Hold potions and food between dives. The stall sells three different potions each visit and food you can stack or buy as a new kind. Placeholdia keeps up to three potions and six kinds of food. One potion and one food stack go Below with you. The dumpster has moldy bread on a fresh save (and another if you took the last one). Vendor rows are pale price tags; the stall has a wooden crate and red jar; moldy bread and root stew have their own icons.
Ghost shop uses a pale cloth counter. Snack, artifact, and pawn rows are light shelves with an icon on the right.
Enemy drops retuned. Keyed HP orbs, mana orbs, and coin pickups roll per kill.
Mid-run quit or crash stores the run as lost: worn run loot and the run root do not survive.
Loading bars fill smoothly with weighted milestones, creep, and per-frame sub-progress. 100% only at finish. Loader weights are per-platform and learned.
Dungeon shadows fixed (cast and enemy grids were empty).
UI restyle passes: crystal buttons match transport pages, tooltips/slot/anvil pickers/confirms/scroll bars follow the host skin, dark text has no outline, crystal focus ring brighter.
Web music streams and plays off the frame loop (HTMLAudio → Web Audio).
Torches: hall cadence fills only dark stretches; light cap raised so the ring lights every torch. Dungeon arrival builds the full light plan under the cover.
Texture import: Detect 3D off so .import files stop rewriting; hub ground and wall sheets Lossless with nearest-mipmap sampling.

Asset rekey pipeline overhauled: cell-median shrink with hard-edge snap, idempotent fit against pre-rekey geometry, soft/notch fixes, approved stills written, stale tile plates replaced with lossless copies.
Warnings swept to zero. Various protocol, sweep, and build-docs cleanups.

entries.summary: Week 7 Grok Build snapshot. Metal HUD with mana and a danger gem, potions and food persist between dives, ghost shop and vendor got their own fronts and icons, loading and lighting cleaned up, and the rekey pipeline hardened.
